title.ja: LBM Re100蓋駆動キャビティ：実2D場とGhia中心線
title.en: LBM Re100 cavity: actual2D fields and Ghia centerlines

summary.ja: 4壁のBGK更新を3固定格子で実行し、nominal蓋速度で正規化したGhia中心線、主渦、定常性と壁運動量収支を検査します。
summary.en: Advance genuine four-wall BGK flow on three fixed grids, checking nominal-lid Ghia centerlines, primary vortex, stationarity and wall momentum budgets.

assumptions.ja: 物理単位正方形、蓋U1、ν.01、Re100。N24/32/48、格子蓋速度.04、dt=.04/N。3壁静止、上壁右向き、同時上面/側面crossingは静止側を優先。初期rho1・静止。
assumptions.en: Physical unit square, lid1, viscosity.01, Re100; N24/32/48, lattice lid.04, dt=.04/N. Three stationary walls/rightward lid; stationary side owns a simultaneous top/side link. Initialrho1/rest.

algorithm.ja: 標準D2Q9平衡分布とBGK衝突、非周期link streaming、q=.5の移動halfway反射。流出入分布ごとに壁impulseを加算し、密度補正や内部速度resetをしません。C++17を一時領域でcompileしPythonから呼びます。
algorithm.en: Standard D2Q9equilibrium/BGK collision, nonperiodic link streaming and moving halfway reflection atq=.5. Sum actual population wall impulses without density repair/interior reset. Compile shipped C++17temporarily and call fromPython.

validation.ja: 各群22pytestと37判定。60k/80k/120k整数stepsでt*=100へ進み90/95/100を保存。最細u/v中心線最大誤差.03、主渦距離.06、95→100相対L2変化2e-4、質量・壁込み運動量ledgerを事前固定します。
validation.en: 22pytest and37case gates. Fixed60k/80k/120ksteps reach t*=100with90/95/100saved. Finest u/v max error.03,vortex distance.06,late relativeL2 change2e-4andmass/wall-inclusive momentum gates are frozen.

limits.ja: 有限Machでの3格子教育例。Ghiaは丸めた独立数値参照で厳密解ではありません。蓋角は不連続で点ごとの二次精度や高Reを主張せず、他手法の既存キャビティ結果を本LBMの成功に流用しません。標準C++17compilerが必要です。
limits.en: Three finite-Mach educational grids. Ghia is a rounded independent numerical reference, not exact. No pointwise corner order/high-Re claim or borrowed success from another cavity solver. A standard C++17compiler is required.

references.author: Qisu Zou and Xiaoyi He
references.title: On pressure and velocity flow boundary conditions and bounceback for the lattice Boltzmann BGK model
references.review_scope: Selected original preprint pp2-7: standard equilibrium, moment-based flat velocity/density boundaries and corner/finite-Mach limitations. No full-paper audit; special d2q9i accuracy is not credited to this standard BGK.

review.ja: 原著preprintの式と平面流入出境界・角・圧縮性の範囲を選択読解。特殊d2q9iの成功を本BGKへ流用しません。
review.en: Selected primary equations and flat-boundary/corner/compressibility discussion read; special d2q9i successes are not borrowed.

references.author: Pierre Lallemand and Li-Shi Luo
references.title: Lattice Boltzmann method for moving boundaries
references.review_scope: Original article sec3 printed410-414 via author-content mirror; quadratic interpolation paths, q=.5, wall correction, momentum exchange and compromised mass conservation. Our two-point linear implementation is separately derived and qualified; original2001BFL full text was inaccessible.

review.ja: 原著の選択部分を著者資料ミラーから読解。今回の2点線形補間は別導出・単step資格で確認し、2001原著全文を読んだとはしません。
review.en: Selected primary section via author-content mirror. The implemented two-point interpolation is separately derived/qualified; no2001full-text claim.
